nodes.notes: POST the signed order here. Expected body: client_name, client_slug, tier, workflows[], approver_name, approver_email, alternate_approver_name, operator_name, dpa_signed, forbidden_actions[], data_boundary.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ event: 'onboarding_blocked', client: $json.client_name, tier: $json.tier, failures: $json.failures, message: 'Onboarding halted before provisioning. No workspace was created.' }) }}

nodes.name: Halt And Notify Ops
nodes.notes: Deliberate dead end. An unqualified or unpapered client must never get a provisioned workspace.

nodes.notes: One keypair per agent, generated relay-side. The private key must never transit this workflow or be logged.
